reason: Both correctly reassure that the buzz is normal induction noise and neither pushes parts or a callout, but Conversation 2 nails the hidden truth in one turn: it specifically names multi-layer sandwich bases vibrating at high power, explains fan run-on as normal (which the homeowner is experiencing), gives practical self-checks (try another pan, lower power, check base flatness) and a precise, relevant 'when to worry' list. Conversation 1 only reaches the pan explanation after the homeowner volunteers the new-stockpot detail, never mentions the fan noise, offers a slightly hand-wavy 'poor magnetic coupling' explanation, and twice appends a boilerplate safety panel about tripping electrics that is irrelevant to this situation and mildly undercuts its own reassurance.
